nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name x-webhook-token, value must match N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN in the app. Without this the webhook can send mail as the company to anyone who finds the URL.

nodes.name: Send email
nodes.notes: Uses the Gmail credential already stored in n8n. Nothing about it reaches the app.

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: The app reads messageId from this response and shows it as confirmation.
